transaction.description: Records the aggregated order value, currency, fulfillment method, and delivery details applied to a purchase transaction.

purchase.description: Fires when a customer completes a purchase with items, pricing, currency, and order confirmation.

ecommerce.description: Contains product list, item quantity, pricing, currency, and transaction ID for cart and purchase events.

kpi_context.description: Records the KPI identifier, measurement scope, and conversion flag indicating whether an event achieved the target action.

user.description: Captures user profile attributes including authentication status, customer segment, loyalty tier, purchase history, and consent flags.

page.description: Records page attributes including URL, page type, content category, checkout step, and session context.

commerce.description: Contains order-level data with order ID, currency, total amount, and visitor conversion flag.

add_to_cart.description: Fires when a user adds an item to cart with item details, unit price, total cart value, and currency.

page_view.description: Fires on every page request with URL, page name, page type, session ID, and user authentication status.

session.description: Records session identifiers, page view count, traffic source, and ad network type.

web.description: Contains the interaction type and page URL with descriptive page name.

cart.description: Records the current cart state including items, prices, checkout progress, payment method, and abandonment timestamps.

kpi.description: Contains pre-calculated KPI values derived from transaction data such as average order value.

session_start.description: Fires at the beginning of a session with engagement duration, page view count, bounce flag, and conversion count.

analytics.description: Contains session metrics including bounce status, engagement time in milliseconds, conversion count, and page views.

sign_up.description: Fires when a user completes account registration with signup method, user ID, and account type.

wishlistAdd.description: Fires when a user saves a product to their wishlist with product ID and visitor identifier.

product.description: Records product attributes including product ID, name, brand, category, price, variant, and stock status.

checkout_conversion_rate.description: Fires at checkout completion with cart state, order details, and user profile identification.

attributes.description: Contains campaign attribution including source, medium, campaign ID, and click identifiers (gclid, fbclid).

view_item.description: Fires when a product detail page is loaded with product, pricing, category, and page referrer.

view_item_list.description: Fires when a product listing or search results page displays with product list metadata and item positions.

productList.description: Records product list metadata including list ID, list name, placement location, and product items array.

select_promotion.description: Fires when a user clicks a promotion banner with promotion ID, name, creative content, and click timestamp.

promotion.description: Records promotion attributes including ID, name, creative name, placement location, and view/click timestamps.

view_search_results.description: Fires when search results are displayed with search term, result count, and transaction context.

privacy.description: Records privacy and consent settings including access categories and applicable domain restrictions.

checkout_error.description: Fires when a payment or checkout step fails with error context, cart state, and payment attempt details.

notification_open.description: Fires when a user opens a transactional notification with notification type, message ID, and user ID.

submit_form.description: Fires when a user submits a form including surveys, contact requests, returns, or preference changes with form data.

generate_lead.description: Fires when a user submits a lead generation form with product context, user ID, and campaign attribution.

search.description: Fires when a user performs a site search with search term, result count, search source, and search type.

select_item.description: Fires when a user selects an item from a recommendation list with item details and purchase or refund context.

listItem.description: Records recommendation list metadata including list ID, list name, and product items with identifiers.

refund.description: Records refund transaction details including refund method, reason code, original order date, and refunded items.

begin_checkout.description: Fires when a user initiates checkout with cart contents, coupon code, and initial checkout step.

form.description: Records form data including form type, submission status, rating value, and fulfillment context.

NPS Survey Submitted.description: Fires when a user submits a Net Promoter Score survey with rating, user ID, and form metadata.

checkout.description: Records checkout progress including step number, step name, and shopping cart identifier.

product_view.description: Fires when a product detail page is viewed with item details, pricing, category, and page context.

filter_apply.description: Fires when a user applies a filter on a product listing page with filter name, value, and results count.

add_to_wishlist.description: Fires when a user adds a product to their wishlist with product details, pricing, and page type.

events.description: Records event-level attributes including event name, action, type, payment type, and checkout step.

add_shipping_info.description: Fires when a user enters shipping address and method with cart, delivery options, and shipping tier.

first_visit.description: Fires on the first visit of a new user with visitor type and acquisition source.

Add to Compare.description: Fires when a user adds a product to a comparison list.

login.description: Fires when a user successfully authenticates with page context, user profile, and customer segment data.

add_payment_info.description: Fires when a user enters payment method with payment type and transaction total.

Checkout Error.description: Fires when a checkout error occurs with error type, code, source, and checkout step.

order.description: Records order details including order ID, transaction ID, shipment status, and tracking number.

campaign.description: Records campaign details including campaign ID, name, media ID, and media name.

order:cancel.description: Fires when a customer cancels an order with cancellation reason, items, and transaction details.

share.description: Fires when a user shares a product with product, page, and user loyalty details.

spend_virtual_currency.description: Fires when a user redeems loyalty points for rewards with redemption ID, reward type, and loyalty tier.

subscribe.description: Fires when a user subscribes to a recurring delivery with subscription ID, items, and total price.

Account Registration.description: Fires when a user completes account registration with registration status, marketing consent, and loyalty enrollment.

First Visit.description: Fires on the first page view by a new user with session details and visitor status.

component.description: Records UI component details including promotion ID, name, creative content, and placement location.

view_promotion.description: Fires when a user is exposed to a promotion banner with promotion ID, name, creative, and page context.

Session Start.description: Fires at the start of each session with session ID, entry page, visitor status, and user returning status.

Product List Click.description: Fires when a user clicks on a product from a listing page with item position, price, and list context.

listing.description: Records product listing metadata including list ID, name, page type, and currency.

items.description: Records product item details including position, brand, category, variant, and price for list display.

Product List View.description: Fires when a product listing page displays with item list ID, name, page type, and items array.

remove_from_cart.description: Fires when a user removes an item from cart with item details, removal method, and cart ID.

shipment.description: Records shipment details including shipment ID, tracking number, carrier, and fulfillment method.

survey.description: Records survey response including rating scale, delivery days, issue reason, and survey channel.

file_download.description: Fires when a user downloads a file with file name, extension, and URL.

Notification Open.description: Fires when a user opens a notification with message ID, channel, campaign ID, and user ID.

contact_support.description: Fires when a user initiates or ends a support chat with session ID, reason, and resolution status.

select_content.description: Fires when a user expands FAQ content or selects search suggestions with item ID and content type.

click.description: Fires when a user clicks an outbound or internal link with URL, domain, and page type.

compare_items.description: Fires when a user adds or removes items from comparison with product details and compare action.

sort_apply.description: Fires when a user applies a sort option on a listing page with sort option and page type.

coupon_apply.description: Fires when a user applies a coupon code with discount value, cart ID, and checkout step.
